artifact_status: Reviewed derived exports; raw generated result bundles are excluded

dataset.split: Reverse-order 90/10 within-workload record split from the pinned tutorial preparation
dataset.candidate_policy: All test records; duplicate/error records retained

derivation_notes: Numerical audit values are retained unchanged.
CSV line endings are normalized to LF; metadata references to published CSV hashes are updated and original audit hashes are retained separately.
Obsolete external-baseline metadata fields are removed after the research scope changed to Jev versus Random; no model measurements are removed.
Pricing attribution is corrected to an assumed audit rate, not user-specified pricing or an invoice.
metrics.csv and summary.json are reviewed exports from uploaded official-weighted summaries, not original-named bundle files.
limitations: Raw measurements, private float32 official throughput labels, prepared shards and actual API request payloads were not supplied.
Runtime-map score recomputation agrees with the uploaded official-label summary within 5.3e-10; exact original-label reconstruction is not claimed.
Paired bootstrap intervals are exploratory, unadjusted and conditional on the saved cohort, Random seed and Jev responses.
Related workload-family dependence is not modeled because family identifiers were unavailable.
Failure-sentinel costs are not physical program execution times; no tournament mean runtime-regret claim is made.
No global tournament Pairwise Accuracy is claimed.
Natural candidate-count groups are confounded by workload composition; they are not a controlled candidate-size ablation.
